title: Transition metals and crystal field theory
summary: d-block metals and their multiple oxidation states; coordination complexes and ligands; d-orbital splitting in octahedral and tetrahedral fields; high-spin and low-spin configurations, colour and magnetism; chelation as a model for treating acute lead poisoning, as lecture 27 frames it.
